items.hed: Texans play Jacksonville in London on Sunday, 8:30 a.m. Central
items.insight: The Houston Texans schedule lists Sunday, Oct. 18, as an away game against the Jacksonville Jaguars at Wembley Stadium, kickoff 8:30 a.m. Central, on NFL Network. Sunday's game at Tennessee is behind them on the club page, which does not print a final, so none is stated here. The next home date is Oct. 25 against the New York Giants, noon Central, on FOX.

items.hed: Astros still have no general manager, and Espada's contract ends this month
items.insight: MLB.com reports the club parted ways with general manager Dana Brown on Aug. 24. Assistant general managers Charles Cook, Gavin Dickey, and Connor Huff, with senior advisor Jeff Bagwell, have carried the work, and owner Jim Crane is overseeing baseball operations. Nearly a week after the White Sox eliminated Houston in two games in the American League Wild Card Series, MLB.com says the search is unchanged. Manager Joe Espada's contract expires at the end of October. No decision is posted.

items.hed: Rockets finished the Macao preseason; the regular season opens Oct. 20
items.insight: The NBA.com page for Sunday's Dallas-Houston game in Macao titles the matchup and dates it Oct. 11, but the readable text does not print a final, so none is stated here. The club's schedule announcement lists the two Macao preseason games for Oct. 9 and Oct. 11. Rosters for opening day are set Oct. 19 at 5 p.m. Eastern, and the regular season starts Oct. 20.
